use bytes::Bytes;

pub const FILE_HANDLE_LEN: i64 = 64;

pub type pdx_trc_id_t = u64;

pub type pdx_file_handle_t = Bytes;

pub type pdx_path_t = String;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct pdx_time_t {
    pub seconds: u32,
    pub nseconds: u32,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(i32)]
pub enum pdx_status_t {
    PDXERR_OK = 0,
    PDXERR_NOENT = 2,
    PDXERR_STALE = 116,
    PDXERR_FAILED = 1001,
}
